definition: Warehouse identity, capacity and database maintenance times. These maintenance times do not document warehouse work.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE warehouse(warehouse_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, warehouse_name TEXT NOT NULL, capacity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(capacity>0), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: Goods identity and product category; NORMAL/FRAGILE describe the goods.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE goods(goods_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, goods_name TEXT NOT NULL, category_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(category_code IN ('NORMAL','FRAGILE')))

definition: Worker identity and job role. role_code identifies a role, not an action performed.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE worker(worker_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, worker_name TEXT NOT NULL, role_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role_code IN ('HANDLER','SUPERVISOR')), updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, payroll_no TEXT)

definition: Business meanings of codes within the specified code family.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE work_code(code_family TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(code_family IN ('MOVEMENT','REQUEST','TASK','HANDLING')), code TEXT NOT NULL, meaning TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(code_family,code))

definition: One submitted request for receipt of one goods type into a warehouse.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE receiving_request(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse(warehouse_id), goods_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goods(goods_id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), submitted_at TEXT NOT NULL)

definition: One actual receipt registration for a receiving request. condition_code describes goods condition, not the receipt action kind.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE goods_receipt(receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES receiving_request(request_id), receiver_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(worker_id), received_at TEXT NOT NULL, condition_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(condition_code IN ('GOOD','DAMAGED')))

definition: One request to dispatch one goods type, with separate actual request and approval times. Priority describes urgency.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE dispatch_order(dispatch_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse(warehouse_id), goods_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goods(goods_id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), priority_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(priority_code IN ('NORMAL','URGENT')), requested_at TEXT NOT NULL, approved_at TEXT, CHECK(approved_at IS NULL OR requested_at<approved_at))

definition: One stock-audit occurrence, its actual start and completion, and its outcome. PASS/RECOUNT describes the result of the same audit kind.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE warehouse_audit(audit_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse(warehouse_id), worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(worker_id), started_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT, result_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_code IN ('PASS','RECOUNT','PENDING')), CHECK((completed_at IS NULL AND result_code='PENDING') OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at<completed_at AND result_code IN ('PASS','RECOUNT'))))

definition: One completed inbound or outbound stock movement; each row records when the movement actually occurred.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE goods_movement(movement_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, warehouse_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse(warehouse_id), goods_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goods(goods_id), quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0), receipt_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES goods_receipt(receipt_id), dispatch_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES dispatch_order(dispatch_id), code_family TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MOVEMENT' CHECK(code_family='MOVEMENT'), movement_code TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(code_family,movement_code) REFERENCES work_code(code_family,code), CHECK((movement_code='IN' AND receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_id IS NULL) OR (movement_code='OUT' AND receipt_id IS NULL AND dispatch_id IS NOT NULL)))

definition: One checking, holding or releasing action performed on a receiving request; repeated checking actions retain separate records.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE request_action(action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES receiving_request(request_id), worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(worker_id), code_family TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'REQUEST' CHECK(code_family='REQUEST'), action_code TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(code_family,action_code) REFERENCES work_code(code_family,code))

definition: One putaway, picking or packing work occurrence, with actual start and optional completion. A repeated attempt has a new task_id.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE warehouse_task_history(task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_id TEXT REFERENCES receiving_request(request_id), dispatch_id TEXT REFERENCES dispatch_order(dispatch_id), worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(worker_id), code_family TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'TASK' CHECK(code_family='TASK'), task_code TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT, outcome_code TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome_code IN ('OK','RETRY','PENDING')), FOREIGN KEY(code_family,task_code) REFERENCES work_code(code_family,code), CHECK((task_code='PUTAWAY' AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_id IS NULL) OR (task_code IN ('PICK','PACK') AND dispatch_id IS NOT NULL AND request_id IS NULL)), CHECK((completed_at IS NULL AND outcome_code='PENDING') OR (completed_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at<completed_at AND outcome_code IN ('OK','RETRY'))))

definition: One unloading or loading occurrence, with actual start and optional completion. A repeated attempt has a new handling_id.
sql_definition: CREATE TABLE handling_history(handling_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, request_id TEXT REFERENCES receiving_request(request_id), dispatch_id TEXT REFERENCES dispatch_order(dispatch_id), worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(worker_id), code_family TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HANDLING' CHECK(code_family='HANDLING'), handling_code TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(code_family,handling_code) REFERENCES work_code(code_family,code), CHECK((handling_code='UNLOAD' AND request_id IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_id IS NULL) OR (handling_code='LOAD' AND dispatch_id IS NOT NULL AND request_id IS NULL)), CHECK(completed_at IS NULL OR started_at<completed_at))

definition: Optional contact attributes of an existing worker, identified by the payroll number. A row describes that worker, not a separate contact entity. Absence of a row means no contact attributes are stored.
sql_definition:
CREATE TABLE worker_contact(
    staff_no TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES worker(payroll_no),
    contact_channel TEXT NOT NULL
)
